name: ThermalEngine
description: An engine typically used in combination with FlowEngine to simulate thermal-hydraulic-mechanical processes. Framework description and demonstration presented within the following paper (Caulk2019a) :Caulk, R.A. and Chareyre, B. (2019) An open framework for the simulation of...

attributes.name: advection
attributes.description: Activates advection

attributes.name: fluidConduction
attributes.description: Activates conduction within fluid

attributes.name: debug
attributes.description: debugging flags

attributes.name: conduction
attributes.description: Activates conduction

attributes.name: thermoMech
attributes.description: Activates thermoMech

attributes.name: fluidThermoMech
attributes.description: Activates thermoMech

attributes.name: solidThermoMech
attributes.description: Activates thermoMech

attributes.name: ignoreFictiousConduction
attributes.description: Allows user to ignore conduction between fictious cells and particles. Mainly for debugging purposes.

attributes.name: bndCondIsTemperature
attributes.description: defines the type of boundary condition for each side of particle packing. True if temperature is imposed, False for no heat-flux. Indices can be retrieved with

attributes.name: thermalBndCondValue
attributes.description: Imposed temperature boundary condition for the particles.

attributes.name: thermalBndFlux
attributes.description: Flux through thermal boundary.

attributes.name: boundarySet
attributes.description: set false to change boundary conditions

attributes.name: useKernMethod
attributes.description: flag to use Kern method for thermal conductivity area calc

attributes.name: useHertzMethod
attributes.description: flag to use hertzmethod for thermal conductivity area calc

attributes.name: useBoBMethod
attributes.description: flag to use Batchelor and O'Brien method for thermal conductivity area calc

attributes.name: fluidBeta
attributes.description: volumetric temperature coefficient m^3/m^3C, default water, <= 0 deactivates

attributes.name: particleT0
attributes.description: Initial temperature of particles

attributes.name: letThermalRunFlowForceUpdates
attributes.description: If true, Thermal will run force updates according to new pressures instead of FlowEngine. only useful if useVolumeChange=false.

attributes.name: flowTempBoundarySet
attributes.description: set false to change boundary conditions

attributes.name: unboundCavityBodies
attributes.description: automatically unbound bodies touching only cavity cells.

attributes.name: particleK
attributes.description: Particle thermal conductivity (W/(mK)

attributes.name: particleCp
attributes.description: Particle thermal heat capacity (J/(kgK)

attributes.name: fluidConductionAreaFactor
attributes.description: Factor for the porethroat area (used for fluid-fluid conduction model)

attributes.name: particleAlpha
attributes.description: Particle volumetric thermal expansion coeffcient

attributes.name: particleDensity
attributes.description: If > 0, this value will override material density for thermodynamic calculations (useful for quasi-static simulations involving unphysical particle densities)

attributes.name: heatGenerationRatio
attributes.description: If > 0, this value will be used to calculate heat generation as a fraction of frictional energy dissipation.

attributes.name: fluidK
attributes.description: Thermal conductivity of the fluid.

attributes.name: uniformReynolds
attributes.description: Control reynolds number in all cells (mostly debugging purposes).

attributes.name: fluidBulkModulus
attributes.description: If > 0, thermalEngine uses this value instead of flow.fluidBulkModulus.

attributes.name: delT
attributes.description: Allows user to apply a delT to solids and observe macro thermal expansion. Resets to 0 after one conduction step.

attributes.name: tsSafetyFactor
attributes.description: Allow user to control the timstep estimate with a safety factor. Default 0.8. If <= 0, thermal timestep is equal to DEM

attributes.name: thermalFreq
attributes.description: If > 1, this value will be used as the frequency of thermal solution (number of DEM steps to solve thermal behavior). Only effective when tsSafetyFactor <= 0, otherwise tsSafetyFactor controls thermal timestep.

attributes.name: porosityFactor
attributes.description: If >0, factors the fluid thermal expansion. Useful for simulating low porosity matrices.

attributes.name: tempDependentFluidBeta
attributes.description: If true, fluid volumetric thermal expansion coefficient, fluidBeta, is temperature dependent (linear model between 20-70 degC)

attributes.name: minimumFluidCondDist
attributes.description: Useful for maintaining stability despite poor external triangulations involving flat tetrahedrals. Consider setting to minimum particle diameter to keep scale.

attributes.name: lenBodies
attributes.description: cache the number of thermal bodies to perform checks and raise warnings if newly inserted bodies are not thermal

attributes.name: ids
attributes.description: Ids list of bodies affected by this PartialEngine.

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: setReynoldsNumbers
methods.description: update the cell reynolds numbers manually (computationally expensive)

methods.name: makeThermal
methods.description: Assign thermal states to all bodies.

methods.name: checkThermal
methods.description: Check if all bodies have thermal states.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
